The width profile is 96 for every row, so there is no silhouette, no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no front face. The column scans show only mottled tonal variation and short dark crack rows (e.g. rows 20-24, 43-47) that read as surface detail, not as structure. This matches the terrain kind, and it shows a flat top-down surface with no vertical face.
